statement_mapping.disposition: Load the same retained IO and arithmetic facade files through paths relative to the additive packet.

All 43 original lines copied contiguously without recurrence, output, arithmetic or control-flow edits. A bounded source-span diff matched; physical source hashing and native execution remain deferred.
Both original quotient assignments remain written and executed through the instrumented facade field. Logged source-line labels derive from consecutive call parity, not a native stack observation.

instrumentation.operand_state_copies: q, r, t and both actual operands are copied before the original facade call; k and emitted are recorded as integers.
instrumentation.result_handling: Copy the full returned binary into the observation, then return the original result value to the recurrence.

sidecar.format: ASCII TSV with LF terminators and exactly ten integer fields per data row
sidecar.second_line: pair	source-line	q	r	t	k	emitted	numerator	denominator	quotient
sidecar.native_ownership_and_size_limits: The source-draft tools/qualification/rebol_work_observations.py supplies the existing owned observer, a fresh owned sidecar path, exact image/source pins and retained bounded policy. Its actual prepared plan, captures and test execution remain pending.

oracle_contract.parse: Accept only canonical signed decimal integers (zero or optional minus followed by nonzero leading digit), exactly ten tab-separated fields and complete LF-terminated rows. Reject malformed, missing, repeated, truncated or extra fields/rows.
oracle_contract.pair_order: Pairs begin at 1 and advance without gaps. Each pair consists of original source lines 15 then 16, with identical q/r/t/k/emitted and denominator t>0.
oracle_contract.quotient_check: Independently compute mathematical floor(numerator/denominator) with unbounded integers for each observed call and require exact equality to its full recorded result.
oracle_contract.equal_branch: When quotient3 equals quotient4, require digit 0..9, append it, set q'=10*q and r'=10*(r-digit*t), preserve t/k, and increase emitted by 1.
oracle_contract.unequal_branch: Otherwise set factor=2*k+1, q'=q*k, r'=(2*q+r)*factor, t'=t*factor, k'=k+1, and preserve emitted. Each update uses the prior state.
oracle_contract.state_replay: The next pair must equal the independently reconstructed next state. Stop only after exactly 27 emitted digits; reject any missing or extra pair.
oracle_contract.unbounded_operand_witness: Require an actual matched pair with an operand magnitude beyond 2^64-1 in each of its two calls; retain which full values establish that witness.
oracle_contract.stdout: Reconstruct the 10-digit row/count and final partial-row format from the independently replayed digits, and require it and actual complete stdout to equal the pinned 45-byte N27 reference.

scope_limits: Instrumented facade-call evidence, not an unchanged-main execution or benchmark sample.
One original facade invocation per observed wrapper call is a reviewed source property; no claim about a count of machine instructions or GMP internal divisions.
The independent pure integer oracle and twelve synthetic test methods are authored but unrun; no actual trace has been reviewed.
Actual runtime/source equivalence, native ownership, primitive qualification, raw output review and source pin freezing are separate prerequisites or gates.
